relationships.subject: Plasma kallikrein
relationships.evidence_quote: which in turn cleaves high molecular weight kininogen (HK) and releases bradykinin (BK)

relationships.subject: ACE
relationships.evidence_quote: Bradykinin is degraded by ACE and other plasma enzymes.

relationships.subject: Ecallantide
relationships.evidence_quote: Ecallantide acts as a plasma kallikrein inhibitor and limits the production of bradykinin from HK.

relationships.subject: Silica nanoparticles
relationships.evidence_quote: SiNP injection induced a rapid, reversible decrease in blood pressure, in the presence of angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE) inhibition.

relationships.subject: Ecallantide
relationships.evidence_quote: Ecallantide blocked the SiNP induced MAP decrease in both captopril pretreated male and female serping1−/− mice

key_findings: Novel Serping1-/- mouse model of acute HAE attacks: SiNP injection plus ACE inhibition (captopril) causes reversible hypotension measured by telemetry.
Ecallantide blocks the SiNP-induced blood pressure drop.
